svg.data-weight: 12.3 kg (27.0 lbs) for the 7280CR3-32D4, 7280CR3K-32D4 and 7280CR3K-32D4A (guide Table 1, data sheet)
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 55.8 cm (19 x 1.75 x 22.0 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-ports-max-speed: four ports of 400 Gbps; 48 of 100 Gbps; 96 of 50 Gbps; 36 of 40 Gbps; 96 of 25 or 10 Gbps
svg.data-power-measure: typical at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports (data sheet)
svg.data-storage-temp: -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2); the data sheet says -40 to 70 C
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent non-condensing (guide Table 2); the data sheet says 5 to 95 percent
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G, 50G, 40G, 25G and 10G with breakout, in the 32 QSFP cages (data sheet)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400G and 100G, in the four QSFP-DD cages (data sheet)
svg.data-console: RJ-45 RS-232 serial on the rear, 9600 baud 8N1, no flow control
svg.data-oob: one 10/100/1000 management port on the rear
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear, for software or configuration updates
svg.data-certifications: BSMI, CE, KCC, NRTL, RCM, UKCA, VCCI, TEC, ANATEL, ICASA (data sheet)
